name: 32637-batchdecode-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, bf16, ungated, ~17 GB of safetensors to fetch.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1 -- 17 GB of weights on an 80 GB card needs no sharding.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration: 36 decoder layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, hidden 4096, KV 147 KB per token, plus a vision tower this workload never enters.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 5120 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, NO IMAGES, no shared prefix, seed 42. Prompts 256 tokens (stdev 32, clamped 192-320); generations pinned at exactly 256 tokens with `ignore_eos: true` at `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A text-only assistant on an 8B multimodal model, serving 256 concurrent users short prompts with fixed-length replies on one H100.
launch:
# One flat `key: value` per line. The reader takes this file line by line and skips indented
# lines, so a nested block or a re-flowed structured value is DROPPED and the engine starts
# without something this setup declares.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
context-length: 2048
# Note the knob's name: `--cuda-graph-max-bs` is a deprecated alias at this commit.
cuda-graph-max-bs-decode: 512
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
disable-radix-cache: true
